scope: Active service ownership and dispatch, single-pass graph preparation/linking, phase order, output side effects, release/docs consolidation, read-only registry, existing emulator/capture delegation, inactive LiveLink. Full-script VM; no real-browser claim.

results.name: Public build and preflight routes have one authoritative service owner
Preflight links one prepared project exactly once; compiling that plan does not relink or publish
Actual compile phase order keeps linking before occupancy/allocation and final CHR bytes
Global Build prepares, links, compiles, commits and requests Save As exactly once
Existing Build & Run uses one current compiler dispatch without a Save As request
Failed compile clears published artifacts and does not run/export a stale ROM
ReleaseInfo owns current version/schema and production has no embedded Scout starter
Current Tech Docs render through one owner without accumulating historical sections
AssetRegistry lookups and validation leave authored data, IDs and history untouched
AssetRegistry validates detached inputs without repairing them or changing live project
EmulatorBridge exposes existing commands and preserves real emulator stepping/reset semantics
EmulatorBridge runtime capture preserves validated pixels and performs one undoable insertion
EmulatorBridge Run Original uses preserved bytes without compiling current editor data
Inactive LiveLink reports no capabilities and rejects apply without side effects
